# agentic-assistant

An AI assistant that acts inside your apps with the user's own permissions.

Keywords: assistant,ai,agent,tools,mcp,sdk,side-panel,approvals,eu,model-port.

- SDK: import { runAssistant, ToolRegistry, createPrincipal } from "agentic-assistant".
- CLI: agentic-assistant chat --tools <mcp-url> --scope <s> --tool-scope <s> "message". MCP server: agentic-assistant mcp. Remote: agentic-assistant tools|approvals|approve <id> --digest <d>|deny <id> --api <url> --api-token-env <NAME>.
- HTTP API: import { createWorker } from "agentic-assistant/worker". Routes under /api/v1: GET /tools, POST /chat (SSE), GET /approvals, POST /approvals/:id/approve|deny. Sign-in with agentic-identity principals. Chat responses carry x-ai-generated: true. Demo: https://agentic-assistant-demo.hello-fd1.workers.dev (needs a bearer key; no model key set, so chat answers 503 not_configured).
- HTTP client: import { createClient, AssistantApiError } from "agentic-assistant/client"; createClient({ baseUrl, token, fetch? }) gives health, tools, chat (async generator of events), approvals, approve(id, digest), deny(id, reason?). Typed errors with code and status.
- AI marking: events carry `provenance`; use provenanceLabel and provenanceMarker (JSON-LD, IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia). Also in HTTP, CLI --json and MCP results.
- Panel: import { AssistantPanel } from "agentic-assistant/react"; import "agentic-design/tokens.css"; import "agentic-assistant/react.css" (colors are agentic-design tokens).
- Account contributor: `import { assistantAccount } from "agentic-assistant/account"`; register it with `createAccountRegistry()` from `agentic-identity/account`. It holds no persistent account data.
- Test provider: import { ScriptedProvider } from "agentic-assistant/testing".
